query:
SELECT 
  leagueNameJp,
  leagueId,
  MAX(CAST(round AS UNSIGNED)) as max_round,
  MAX(FROM_UNIXTIME(kickoffUtcMs/1000 + 9*3600, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i')) as latest_jst,
  SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(round AS UNSIGNED) >= 160 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as final_count
FROM matches
WHERE leagueId IN ('4480','4481','5071','4482','4570','4483','4506','4485','4484','4510')
GROUP BY leagueNameJp, leagueId
ORDER BY leagueId;
